macros.name: textgvibc
macros.doc: The command \textgvibc{⟨text⟩} typesets ⟨text⟩ in the Greek font.

macros.name: translitgvibc
macros.doc: \translitgvibc{⟨commands⟩} will typeset ⟨commands⟩ (those in the last column of Table 1) as modern glyphs instead of the archaic ones.

macros.name: translitgvibcfont
macros.doc: The transliterated text is set in the \translitgvibcfont font, which is initialised to a math roman form (i.e., \mathrm).
